object.attr: analysis: an agent can replace an issued PDF without anyone seeing it; asking to replace makes that a choice the call records. The parameter is off by default and goes in MELLON-MCP-SRS-36's table; it breaks agents that re-export over a file, so it needs an upgrade note (review Q48). Test with a hard link too (CF-P8).
object.description: If the MCP server's export tool is given an output path that names an existing file, the MCP server shall refuse the export unless the call asks to replace the file.
